items.title: Monday recap: 49ers beat Commanders, and what it means for fantasy
items.dek: Christian McCaffrey put up 28.9 PPR points. How it happened, every fantasy-relevant line, who's rising, who's falling and who to grab off waivers.
body: The 49ers beat the Commanders 23-17. The 49ers are 6-0; the Commanders fall to 1-4-1. The 40 combined points came in well under the 51.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it.
The 49ers struck first in the 1st quarter: George Kittle 11 Yd pass from Brock Purdy (Eddy Pineiro Kick). In all there were 5 touchdowns.

Brock Purdy completed 20 of 28 passes for 261 yards with 1 touchdown, adding 28 yards on the ground (17.2 PPR points, 5.5 below our 22.7 projection). Christian McCaffrey ran 14 times for 59 yards and 2 touchdowns, plus 8 catches for 50 yards (28.9 PPR points, 9.1 above our 19.8 projection), easily his top game of the year. He took 64% of the running back carries. Kaelon Black ran 8 times for 34 yards, plus 1 catch for 3 yards (4.7 PPR points, right around our 4.4 projection). George Kittle caught 5.0 of 8 targets for 69 yards and 1 touchdown (17.9 PPR points, 3.4 above our 14.5 projection). He drew 29% of the team's targets, the volume of a true number one. Mike Evans caught 3.0 of 5 targets for 94 yards (12.4 PPR points, right around our 13.5 projection).

Jayden Daniels completed 27 of 34 passes for 274 yards with 2 touchdowns (20.0 PPR points, 5.0 above our 15.0 projection). Rachaad White ran 7 times for 27 yards, plus 3 catches for 21 yards and a receiving score (13.8 PPR points, 3.3 above our 10.5 projection). He handled 88% of the running back carries; that kind of volume holds up. Stefon Diggs caught 6.0 of 7 targets for 44 yards and 1 touchdown (16.4 PPR points, 9.0 above our 7.4 projection). Chig Okonkwo caught 7.0 of 7 targets for 69 yards (13.9 PPR points, 8.2 above our 5.7 projection), his best game of the season. Treylon Burks caught 4.0 of 5 targets for 66 yards (10.6 PPR points, 5.6 above our 5.0 projection).
Christian McCaffrey (RB, SF): 28.9 points vs a 19.8 projection; 9 targets is real volume.
Stefon Diggs (WR, WAS): 16.4 points vs a 7.4 projection; the role is growing.
Terry McLaurin (WR, WAS): 3.7 points on a 11.0 projection, only 1 target.
Chig Okonkwo (TE, WAS, rostered in 18% of leagues): 13.9 points on 7 targets. One week is not a role, so check his snaps first.
The 49ers visit the Falcons in week 7; Christian McCaffrey projects for 18.4 points. The Commanders host the Eagles in week 8; Jayden Daniels projects for 16.1 points.

items.title: Week 6 Sunday recap: the performances, surprises and waiver adds that matter
items.dek: Every score, the best fantasy days, who's rising and falling, injuries to watch and the first waiver targets of the week.
body: 11 games are in the books. The biggest surprise: the Titans beat the Colts as 6.5-point underdogs. The Texans-Jaguars game was the highest-scoring at 65 points. Malik Nabers led every fantasy scorer with 28.5 PPR points.
Malik Nabers caught 12 of 15 targets for 165 yards (28.5 PPR points, 13.6 above our 14.9 projection).
Kenneth Walker III ran 19 times for 128 yards and 2 touchdowns, plus 2 catches for 11 yards (27.9 PPR points, 8.3 above our 19.6 projection).
Trevor Lawrence completed 24 of 41 passes for 306 yards with 4 touchdowns and 1 interception (27.3 PPR points, 10.7 above our 16.6 projection), easily his top game of the year.
Tyler Shough completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards with 3 touchdowns, adding 32 yards on the ground and 1 rushing score (27.0 PPR points, 10.6 above our 16.4 projection), a season high.
Tre Tucker caught 5 of 7 targets for 97 yards and 2 touchdowns (26.7 PPR points, 16.8 above our 9.9 projection), a season high.
Germie Bernard caught 11 of 12 targets for 87 yards and 1 touchdown (25.7 PPR points, 16.3 above our 9.4 projection), a season high.

The Texans survived the Jaguars, 34-31. The Texans are 2-4; the Jaguars fall to 4-2. The 65 combined points blew past the 42.5-point total, the kind of game fantasy managers dream about. Trevor Lawrence posted 27.3 points. Bhayshul Tuten posted 24.7 points on 12 carries.
The Patriots pulled away from the Jets for a 26-19 win. The Patriots are 4-2; the Jets fall to 2-4. Drake Maye posted 23.8 points. Omar Cooper Jr. posted 22.3 points on 7 targets.

The Steelers pulled away from the Buccaneers for a 26-19 win. The Steelers are 4-2; the Buccaneers fall to 1-5. Germie Bernard posted 25.7 points on 12 targets. DK Metcalf posted 20.3 points on 15 targets.

The Titans won outright as 6.5-point underdogs, beating the Colts 26-20. The Titans are 1-5; the Colts fall to 2-4. Jonathan Taylor posted 21.1 points on 21 carries. Carnell Tate posted 19.0 points on 7 targets.

The Browns won outright as 3-point underdogs, beating the Ravens 13-10. The Browns are 4-2; the Ravens fall to 4-2. The 23 combined points came in well under the 39.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it. Josh Cuevas posted 14.4 points. Tyler Huntley posted 13.4 points.
The Bears pulled away from the Falcons for a 31-23 win. The Bears are 4-2; the Falcons fall to 2-4. D'Andre Swift posted 23.0 points on 16 carries. Kyle Pitts posted 23.0 points on 7 targets.
The Panthers pulled away from the Eagles for a 25-14 win. The Panthers are 3-2; the Eagles fall to 2-4. Tommy Tremble posted 20.6 points. DeVonta Smith posted 20.5 points on 14 targets.

The Saints pulled away from the Giants for a 34-27 win. The Saints are 2-4; the Giants fall to 3-2-1. The 61 combined points blew past the 46.5-point total, the kind of game fantasy managers dream about. Malik Nabers posted 28.5 points on 15 targets. Tyler Shough posted 27.0 points.

The Cardinals won outright as 12.5-point underdogs, beating the Rams 18-16. The Cardinals are 2-4; the Rams fall to 2-4. The 34 combined points came in well under the 51.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it. Matthew Stafford posted 16.9 points. Colby Parkinson posted 14.1 points on 6 targets.
The Bills survived the Raiders, 33-30. The Bills are 5-1; the Raiders fall to 3-3. Tre Tucker posted 26.7 points on 7 targets. James Cook posted 24.3 points on 22 carries.

The Chiefs pulled away from the Chargers for a 22-6 win. The Chiefs are 5-0; the Chargers fall to 0-6. The 28 combined points came in well under the 41.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it. Kenneth Walker III posted 27.9 points on 19 carries. Xavier Worthy posted 14.3 points on 7 targets.
Omar Cooper Jr. (WR, NYJ): 22.3 points out of nowhere; the role is growing.
Tre Tucker (WR, LV): 26.7 points vs a 9.9 projection; the role is growing.
Germie Bernard (WR, PIT): 25.7 points vs a 9.4 projection; 12 targets is real volume.
Tommy Tremble (TE, CAR): 20.6 points vs a 4.3 projection; the touchdowns did the heavy lifting, so temper expectations.
Bijan Robinson (RB, ATL): 7.3 points on a 20.6 projection, only 9 carries.
Derrick Henry (RB, BAL): 5.0 points on a 17.2 projection, 17 carries went for just 58 yards.

items.title: Packers 23, Cowboys 13: winners, losers and waiver adds
items.dek: Matthew Golden put up 22.4 PPR points. How it happened, every fantasy-relevant line, who's rising, who's falling and who to grab off waivers.
body: The Packers beat the Cowboys 23-13. The Packers are 4-2; the Cowboys fall to 2-4. The 36 combined points came in well under the 53.5-point total, and fantasy scoring suffered for it.

Jordan Love completed 23 of 41 passes for 276 yards with 1 touchdown and 1 interception, adding 1 rushing score (20.2 PPR points, 3.1 above our 17.1 projection). Pierre Strong ran 11 times for 28 yards, plus 5 catches for 39 yards (11.7 PPR points, 6.7 above our 5.0 projection). He split the work, taking 55% of the running back carries. MarShawn Lloyd ran 8 times for 10 yards (1.0 PPR points, 9.8 below our 10.8 projection). Matthew Golden caught 6 of 13 targets for 104 yards and 1 touchdown (22.4 PPR points, 9.3 above our 13.1 projection), a season high. He drew 32% of the team's targets, the volume of a true number one. Christian Watson caught 3 of 8 targets for 64 yards (9.4 PPR points, 6.4 below our 15.8 projection). Tucker Kraft caught 5 of 8 targets for 37 yards (8.7 PPR points, right around our 11.0 projection).

Dak Prescott completed 34 of 54 passes for 258 yards with 1 touchdown and 2 interceptions (11.0 PPR points, 7.1 below our 18.1 projection). Javonte Williams ran 11 times for 41 yards and 1 touchdown, plus 2 catches for 9 yards (13.0 PPR points, 4.1 below our 17.1 projection). He handled 85% of the running back carries; that kind of volume holds up. CeeDee Lamb caught 9 of 18 targets for 70 yards (16.0 PPR points, right around our 17.9 projection). He drew 33% of the team's targets, the volume of a true number one. George Pickens caught 6 of 11 targets for 73 yards (13.3 PPR points, right around our 14.1 projection). Ryan Flournoy caught 7 of 9 targets for 40 yards and 1 touchdown (17.0 PPR points, 9.0 above our 8.0 projection), his best game of the season.
Matthew Golden (WR, GB): 22.4 points vs a 13.1 projection; 13 targets is real volume.
Ryan Flournoy (WR, DAL): 17.0 points vs a 8.0 projection; 9 targets is real volume.
MarShawn Lloyd (RB, GB): 1.0 points on a 10.8 projection, only 8 carries.
Dak Prescott (QB, DAL): 11.0 points on a 18.1 projection, a rough day through the air.
Christian Watson (WR, GB): 9.4 points on a 15.8 projection, 8 targets but only 3 for 64 yards.
Ryan Flournoy (WR, DAL, rostered in 10% of leagues): 17.0 points on 9 targets. One week is not a role, so check his snaps first.

The Packers visit the Lions in week 7; Jordan Love projects for 17.1 points against a Lions defense that has allowed the most fantasy points to QBs. The Cowboys visit the Eagles in week 7; CeeDee Lamb projects for 17.9 points against an Eagles defense that has allowed the 4th-most fantasy points to WRs.
